content.text: Steps are stacked plate layers — overlaps expected. Laying the crepidoma.
Stylobate is down. Now 16 slender round columns, 5 bricks tall, in white.
Cella wall ring, 5 courses of tan brick with a doorway on the front end.
Entablature beam ring on the column tops, plus a matching course on the cella, then the ceiling slab.
Low-pitch stepped roof: white pediment gables at both ends, tan slopes between.
